title: WCAG 2.2 / EAA & ADA Accessibility Legal Risk Auditor Input
description: Provide one or more public website URLs to audit for WCAG 2.2 Level A/AA compliance, third-party accessibility overlay widgets (accessiBe, UserWay, AudioEye, etc.), EAA Accessibility Statement links, annotated visual screenshot evidence, and HTML remediation code snippets.

urls.title: Target Website URLs
urls.description: List of public HTTP/HTTPS URLs to audit (supports URL strings like ["https://example.com"] or RequestList objects like [{"url": "https://example.com"}]).

url.title: Single Website URL (Optional Shorthand)
url.description: Optional single URL convenience field for REST webhooks, Clay HTTP columns, or MCP calls.

wcagLevel.title: Target WCAG 2.2 Conformance Level
wcagLevel.description: Target W3C conformance level. Level AA is the global regulatory benchmark for EU EAA (EN 301 549) and US DOJ ADA Title II/III.

includeVisualEvidence.title: Generate Annotated Red-Box Screenshot Evidence
includeVisualEvidence.description: Injects red bounding boxes and numbered badges onto violating DOM elements, captures a PNG screenshot, and saves it to the Apify Key-Value Store (+$0.015/URL).

fullPageScreenshot.title: Full-Page Screenshot
fullPageScreenshot.description: Capture the full scrollable page height instead of the above-the-fold desktop viewport (1440x900).

detectOverlays.title: Detect Accessibility Overlay Widgets
detectOverlays.description: Detects third-party overlay scripts and DOM signatures (accessiBe, UserWay, AudioEye, EqualWeb, Recite Me, Monsido, MaxAccess, User1st, Facil'iti).

checkAccessibilityStatement.title: Check EAA Multilingual Accessibility Statement
checkAccessibilityStatement.description: Scans navigation and footer links across EN/DE/FR/ES/IT/NL for mandatory European Accessibility Act (EAA) statement disclosures.

respectRobotsTxt.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobotsTxt.description: Checks domain /robots.txt rules before scanning and skips disallowed paths.

maxUrls.title: Max URLs Safety Cap
maxUrls.description: Hard ceiling on the total number of URLs audited in a single run to prevent accidental budget overruns.

domainDelayMs.title: Per-Domain Polite Delay (ms)
domainDelayMs.description: Minimum delay in milliseconds between consecutive requests to the same hostname.

navigationTimeoutSecs.title: Page Navigation Timeout (seconds)
navigationTimeoutSecs.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for each page load and DOM stabilization.

maxViolationsPerUrl.title: Max Detailed Remediation Snippets per URL
maxViolationsPerUrl.description: Maximum number of prioritized violations with Before/After HTML diffs included per URL.
